# AUDIO PROFILE: Belang, a cheeky orange cat, level-1 soldier and hero of a fantasy MMORPG-style animated adventure; narrates his own quest.
## SCENE: a bright fantasy kingdom; he is excited, reckless, funny.
### DIRECTOR'S NOTES
Style: fun, energetic adventure narrator, playful and comedic, punchy delivery on jokes, amused self-mockery.
Pacing: lively and brisk but clear; short comic pause at '...'.
Accent: natural casual Jakarta Indonesian, no foreign accent.
